title: StrategyConfigUpdateRequest
description: UI-P3-b (strategy-config-write): input for the dark-gated, reduce-or-hold-risk runtime config write. The dashboard POSTs to api-gateway POST /strategy-config, which starts a short-lived StrategyConfigUpdateWorkflow on orchestrator-core, synchronously reads its StrategyConfigUpdateResult, and maps the result outcome to an HTTP status. The activity drives StrategyConfigWriter.update(tenant, strategy, config, expectedVersion, actor) — a compare-and-set gated on the reduce-or-hold-risk field-class rules. DARK by default: the api-gateway route 404s unless strategy.config.write.enabled=true. Carries NO secret/key material — config is a plain StrategyConfig blob.

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. See CopytradeSignalPayload.schema_version. Workers reject newer-than-build inputs.

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose strategy config is being written. The api-gateway asserts this equals the validated X-Tenant-Id before starting the workflow; StrategyConfigWriter's IDENTITY field-class check additionally hard-blocks any drift between this and config.tenant_id / the stored row.

strategy_id.description: Strategy whose config row is the compare-and-set target for (tenant_id, strategy_id). The writer's NOT_FOUND / IDENTITY gates are authoritative — a wrong/absent strategy yields NOT_FOUND, never a write.

config.description: The proposed full StrategyConfig blob. Reuses the generated StrategyConfig DTO (like strategy-config.json's nested objects). StrategyConfigWriter validates it standalone, then enforces the reduce-or-hold-risk field-class rules against the currently-stored row before the CAS UPDATE.

expected_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the version the caller read. The CAS UPDATE matches WHERE version = expected_version; a stale value (a concurrent writer won) yields REJECTED_STALE_VERSION.

actor.description: Who/what caused the write (e.g. the api-gateway route id). Recorded on the audit event and the strategy_config row's updated_by.

correlation_id.description: OPTIONAL cross-event correlation key (e.g. the originating request id). Embedded in the workflow id so a retried api-gateway call dedups on REJECT_DUPLICATE rather than double-writing.
